description: Capability handles (memory objects, rights, map, transfer). userspace/system_apps/handle_test exercises handle_create_memory/handle_write/handle_read/map/transfer end to end. Also a regression guard for the sys_handle_read scratch-allocation bound (kernel/src/syscall/mod.rs): the per-read kernel buffer is clamped to MAX_MEMORY_OBJECT so a userspace-controlled length can no longer drive an unbounded kernel allocation. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_handle_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: memory-object create/write/read (bounded scratch), rights enforcement, map and transfer all succeeded

forbidden.why: kernel panic (e.g. an allocation abort on the handle-read path)
a handle operation returned the wrong result
